title: ID0401860-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197009] SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12 & Black Display
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12
and display is black
Root cause: HMI internal controller is faulty and KF12 faulty
Solution: Replace HMI and KF12
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Active
28/01/2025 : RC Handover
Note from L2: I was not able to get the EcoG logs since RC reached out to me when he reached the site and I don't have SSH access to get them, we tried a different ethernet cable and didn't work. Site is like 6 hours aways from RC's work and we couldn't wait for the access.
HMI controller was tested to the input and found 24V so from there it's the PCB, cannot be tested. RC will provide the photo as soon as he can

additional_info.subject: Solicitação de atendimento - Shell Recharge I Hotel HD Park - Assis
additional_info.body:
Boa tarde, prezados,
Espero que estejam bem.
@Pinto, Joao Paulo De Camargo Torres
, gostaria de abrir um chamado para a estação do HD Park em Assis, pois estamos enfrentando alguns problemas que necessitam de atenção urgente na estação Y2/R4313020197009. Em anexo, envio um vídeo que mostra que o display do carregador está apagado, mesmo estando em funcionamento. Além disso, o Plug 1 está apresentando falha, ficando indisponível em diversos momentos, enquanto o Plug 2 segue disponível normalmente. Por fim, observei que diversas cargas começam, mas se encerram automaticamente após cerca de 2 minutos.
Nos logs da estação, identifiquei um erro relacionado ao Relé “SafetyRelay_QA26”, o que pode estar relacionado às falhas mencionadas.
Acredito que uma visita técnica in loco seja necessária para uma análise mais detalhada e resolução dos problemas. Conto com a colaboração de vocês para um retorno o mais breve possível.
Endereço do local : Av. Valter Antônio Fontana, 1951 – Vila Claudia, Assis - SP, 19815-340.
Caso precisem de mais alguma informação, estou à disposição.
Agradeço desde já pela atenção e aguardo um retorno.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401860-DC/Si-D/DBR-[Y2 / R3 313020197009] Charging issue DC1 & Black Display CRM:00643001223
additional_info.body:
Hi Rafael,
I noticed that the charger is running an older firmware version. After analyzing the logs, it appears that the EcoG of DC Outlet 1 is not communicating with the PLC. If this issue is software-related, updating the charger to the latest version may help minimize the problem.
Regarding the black display, we can schedule the intervention after updating the charger to the latest version so that if its related to Hardware we can arrange for the spares as well. Currently, it is running version v4, and we can update it to v5, followed by the latest version, v6.0.3.
Please let me know the date and time for the update.
Thank you.
With best regards,

3.Use MobaXterm to check if we can ping the EcoG IP address. If not, please try replacing the Ethernet cable.

Hi Team,
Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem
but the customer can able to charger the EV
, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 : Adaptation Set
8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0  : Controlpanel CCR Contactless no AC Gen2
Thank you.
